note: STALE_STATE error of contract.proveCall (and of contract.findBonos with minLeafCount): the indexer state cannot be used for proving. data.reason: old (block older than the freshness limit, 120 s), future (block more than 60 s ahead of the local clock: the computer clock is behind), behind (fewer leaves in the bono tree than minLeafCount). data.ageMs: local clock minus the block time, in ms (negative if the block is ahead). data.leafCount: only with behind, the leaves of the tree that was read (example in "behind").
